summary.text: Loren Petty is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 22A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Kelly Walton.
A Marine Corps veteran and former roofing-business worker, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports public education and opposes Idaho's private-school voucher program.

paragraphs.text: Loren Petty was born in Boise, Idaho, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1977 to 1981, and graduated from Capital High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Boise State University in 2001, and his career experience includes work as a construction professional.
In his survey he said he served as a Marine infantryman, worked in the family roofing business from 1981 to 2021, and published a newsprint periodical called Boise Times from 1992 to 1997.
Petty ran for the same seat in 2024, when incumbent John Vander Woude won the general election.
In his 2026 survey he also named Idaho's abortion law, the state minimum wage, tenant protections and campaign finance among his concerns.
